apps/api/src/threads/thread-stop.ts.name: Stop thread runs
apps/api/src/threads/thread-stop.ts.description: Cancels a thread's active runs and helpers under the thread lock and clears pending steering.

apps/api/src/threads/runs.ts.name: Run activity list
apps/api/src/threads/runs.ts.description: Lists active and recent runs per chat for the activity view, hiding background triggers.

packages/adapters/src/runs/lifecycle/run.name: Run completion
packages/adapters/src/runs/lifecycle/run.description: Finalizes a finished turn into a reply and enqueues memory retention and history compaction jobs.

packages/adapters/src/runs/assembly/run-.name: Turn assembly pipeline
packages/adapters/src/runs/assembly/run-.description: Sequences records, history, model, tools and prompt loading into one assembled turn or undefined.

packages/adapters/src/runs/assembly/run-.name: History and turn context
packages/adapters/src/runs/assembly/run-.description: Builds labelled thread history and loads memory, scratchpad, tickets and recalled memory for the turn.

packages/adapters/src/runs/assembly/run-.name: Turn prompt builder
packages/adapters/src/runs/assembly/run-.description: Composes the user-turn prompt, current-time block and the history plus recall sent to the runtime.

packages/adapters/src/runs/assembly/run-.name: Model and tool selection
packages/adapters/src/runs/assembly/run-.description: Picks the turn's model and backups, prepares the computer and selects the tools offered to the run.

packages/adapters/src/runs/assembly/run-.name: Backup model loader
packages/adapters/src/runs/assembly/run-.description: Loads the run's backup models, excluding the running model unless another account serves it.

packages/adapters/src/runs/assembly/run-.name: Lease-fenced event writes
packages/adapters/src/runs/assembly/run-.description: Wraps event appends with the run's owner and fence so a superseded attempt cannot write.

packages/adapters/src/runs/assembly/run-.name: System prompt builder
packages/adapters/src/runs/assembly/run-.description: Assembles the system instructions from platform rules, bot instructions, tools, skills and reply guidance.

packages/adapters/src/runs/turn/run-mode.name: Model turn driver
packages/adapters/src/runs/turn/run-mode.description: Builds the AgentRunRequest, runs the runtime, consumes its events and completes or fails the run.

packages/adapters/src/runs/turn/run-turn.name: Runtime event consumer
packages/adapters/src/runs/turn/run-turn.description: Streams runtime events into thread progress events while checking the lease once a second.

packages/adapters/src/runs/turn/run-turn.name: Tool call event handling
packages/adapters/src/runs/turn/run-turn.description: Shows tool steps, appends agent.tool.called and stops a run caught in a repeating tool loop.

packages/adapters/src/runs/turn/run-turn.name: Turn images and steering
packages/adapters/src/runs/turn/run-turn.description: Loads turn images and claims steering messages that join a running turn.

packages/adapters/src/runs/tools/run-too.name: Tool dispatch
packages/adapters/src/runs/tools/run-too.description: Gates each tool call through refusal checks and approvals, then runs its handler and audits it.

packages/adapters/src/runs/tools/run-too.name: Tool call gate
packages/adapters/src/runs/tools/run-too.description: Decides whether a tool call runs, asks for approval, is auto-reviewed or refused, and records its effect.

packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/pi-runt.name: Pi agent runtime
packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/pi-runt.description: Drives the Pi agent loop and maps its events to runtime events with resume, steering and fallback handling.

packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/pi-runt.name: Model fallback stream
packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/pi-runt.description: Retries a model call with backoff, learns provider limits and switches to usable backup models.

packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/stream/.name: Reliable model stream
packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/stream/.description: Wraps provider streaming with header and idle timeouts, retry options and idle abort relabeling.

packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/tools/p.name: Pi tool adapter
packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/tools/p.description: Converts connector tools to Pi tools, handling argument prep, pauses, checkpoint capture and result clipping.

packages/adapters/src/runtime/context/ru.name: Context policy
packages/adapters/src/runtime/context/ru.description: Shapes the transcript before each model call, keeping a cache-stable prefix and rebuilding when it pays off.

packages/adapters/src/runtime/context/hi.name: History compaction
packages/adapters/src/runtime/context/hi.description: Selects compacted history and summarizes older thread messages in batches for the legacy strategy.

packages/adapters/src/runtime/context/hi.name: Compaction prompts
packages/adapters/src/runtime/context/hi.description: Holds the summarizer instructions and formats compacted summaries and recalled memory as untrusted data.

packages/adapters/src/runtime/runtime-st.name: Runtime stream cleanup
packages/adapters/src/runtime/runtime-st.description: Aborts executor tool work before closing an interrupted runtime event iterator.

packages/adapters/src/runtime/acp/acp-ru.name: ACP CLI runtime
packages/adapters/src/runtime/acp/acp-ru.description: Runs a CLI agent over ACP, reusing the Pi tool adapter and shell stream helpers.

packages/adapters/src/tasks/background-h.name: Background helpers
packages/adapters/src/tasks/background-h.description: Starts subagent runs with a parallel cap and returns their results as follow-up runs.

packages/db/src/threads/thread-steering..name: Steering claim
packages/db/src/threads/thread-steering..description: Claims queued steering messages for a running turn under the thread lock.

packages/core/src/threads/thread-subscri.name: Thread subscription client
packages/core/src/threads/thread-subscri.description: Recovers a durable event stream with cursor replay, backoff and idle-timeout detection for web and mobile.

apps/web/src/pages/shell/chat/use-thread.name: Web thread sync
apps/web/src/pages/shell/chat/use-thread.description: Loads the open chat, applies live events to its snapshot and pages in older history.

packages/adapter-kit/src/types.ts.name: Adapter contracts
packages/adapter-kit/src/types.ts.description: Defines the runtime request and event types, job payloads and the default context strategy.
